20.name: Grilled Chicken with Sesame Seeds
20.note: Grilled chicken with sesame seeds sprinkled on top.

components.title: Tex Mex Baked Chicken
ingredients: 1 tsp each garlic powder and onion powder
instructions: Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all the spices and sprinkle on the chicken on both sides.
Place on a baking dish and bake about 25 minutes or until done.

components.title: Fruity Rice Salad
ingredients: ¼ to ⅓ cup sliced almonds, toasted
instructions: Cook rice and quinoa per instructions.
Fold the quinoa into the rice.
In a large bowl whisk the lime juice, zest, EVOO, vinegar and s&p to taste.
Add the rice and quinoa mixture to the bowl, folding in the cucumber, mango, scallions and cilantro.
Mix well and then fold in the almonds.

components.title: Mexican Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 tsp each of chili powder and cumin
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl except for the avocado.
Serve with sliced avocado on top.

components.title: Avocado Egg White Salad
instructions: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients and serve.

components.title: Brown Rice with Tomatoes and Basil
ingredients: 1 cup packed basil leaves (1 large bunch), chopped
instructions: Bring 2¼ cups water to a boil and add the rice and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Return to a boil, cover, and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, until the rice is tender and all the water is absorbed.
Transfer the rice to a bowl.
Whisk together the vinegar, sweetener, olive oil, remaining teaspoon of salt, and a pinch of pepper.
Pour over the rice.
Add the tomatoes and basil.
Mix well and check the seasonings.

components.title: Brown Spinach Rice
instructions: Cook rice as prescribed, and right before it is done cooking, put the frozen spinach in, mix well, cover and let finish cooking.
May fold in a little Parmesan cheese if desired.

components.title: Brown Spinach Rice
instructions: Cook rice as prescribed, and right before it is done cooking, put the frozen spinach in, mix well, cover and let finish cooking.
May fold in a little Parmesan cheese if desired.

components.title: Artichoke Crusted Chicken
ingredients: 1 can quartered artichoke hearts, rinsed, drained and chopped finely
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile in a bowl, mix the yogurt, artichokes and Parmesan cheese.
Sprinkle grill seasoning on both sides of the chicken and bake for 10 minutes.
Take the chicken out of the oven, add the artichoke mixture and bake for another 10 minutes.

components.title: Creamy Cauliflower Rice
instructions: In a saucepan with a little stock, cook the garlic, and toast the rice.
Add the water and cook until done.
In another large saucepan, boil the cauliflower until softened.
In a food processor, add the cauliflower, yogurt, s&p to taste, and stock if needed to thin out.
When the rice is cooked, take off the heat, add the cauliflower mixture, fold in well, add mozzarella if using, and fold again.

components.title: Tex-Mex Turkey Meatloaf
ingredients: ½ cup fresh salsa, plus more for the top
1 tbsp each of oregano, cumin and chili powder
½ cup or more Greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine all the ingredients and mix well.
Mold into a meatloaf on a lined baking sheet.
Top with salsa and bake for 20-25 minutes.

ingredients: ¼ cup coconut oil, melted and cooled
Sweetener to taste (brown sugar, agave, etc)
3-4 tbsp dairy & gluten free chocolate chips
1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
¼ to ⅓ cup honey or agave
3 tbsp coconut sugar or brown sugar

instructions: In a bowl, combine eggs, onions, celery, avocado and mustard.
Stir well and add paprika and s&p to taste.

ingredients: 1 tsp vanilla, coconut, maple or almond extract

Toppings or fillings, pick any: ¼ cup freeze dried berries, ¼ cup chopped walnuts, ¼ cup sliced almonds, ¼ cup shredded coconut, ¼ cup dairy and gluten-free chocolate chips, ¼ cup fresh berries or banana
1 cup plain low fat Greek yogurt
Sweetener to taste (honey, agave, brown sugar, coconut sugar)
1 cup strawberries, half inside the batter and half for the top
Almond milk (¼ cup plus), added to the blender as needed to get the right consistency
½ cup almonds or walnuts (optional), for crunch and healthy fats
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and spray a muffin pan (silicone if you have one) with coconut oil spray and wipe down.
Place all of the ingredients except the strawberries in a blender or food processor, and blend until the oats are smooth.
Fold in half the strawberries.
Pour into the muffin pan and top off with a few strawberries.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown and done.

lunch: Baked or grilled chicken or steak and Fruity Rice Salad

easySnacks: Fruit + ¼ cup almond, cashew or sun butter
Fruit + ¼ cup almonds, cashews or pumpkin seeds
Hard boiled egg whites + avocado or guacamole

extraRecipes.name: Chicken with Nectarine Salad
extraRecipes.note: From Michelle's Eat to be Fit cooking class #7. The 2nd-edition PDF lists it on week 1 but left the recipe out.

components.title: Chicken with Nectarine Salad
ingredients: ½ tbsp coconut sugar or brown sugar
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the first 6 ingredients and rub onto both sides of the chicken breasts.
Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until done.
In a separate bowl, combine the remaining ingredients, except the avocado, and fold it in at the end.
To serve, plate the chicken and top with the salsa.

extraRecipes.name: Veggie Rice Supreme
extraRecipes.note: From Michelle's BeFit Moms recipes. Serve with grilled chicken, steak or fish, as the week 5 calendar says.

components.title: Veggie Rice Supreme
ingredients: ½ cup part skim shredded mozzarella
instructions: Cook brown rice until done.
When the rice is almost done, heat a nonstick skillet with stock, add the veggies and garlic to the pan.
Sprinkle with basil and S&P and sauté for about 5 minutes.
Stir veggies, rice and cheese together and serve.

extraBreakfasts.title: Zucchini & Spinach Frittata
extraBreakfasts.note: From Michelle's Eat to be Fit cooking class #7. Make it Saturday and the leftovers cover a couple more mornings.
instructions: In a skillet with a little stock, cook the zucchini, spinach and thyme with a little S&P until the spinach is wilted and the zucchini is cooked. Let cool.
Meanwhile, whisk the eggs and cottage cheese and add the veggie mixture in.
Pour into a 9-inch pie plate and bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until done.
